display_name: 三个独立 CPU 进程与共享推理的源域对照
description: 冻结模型于 112 条源 IQ 上对比三个 CPU 子进程并行与单进程共享推理，逐字节比较结果。

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only fixed models, one actual CPU parallel timing and bitwise output comparison; not full target equivalence

checkpoint.initialization: Original DURA, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL classifier and three separately frozen source-only correction models
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: ground.load_fixed verifies each source checkpoint and frozen model; common DURA and F weights are compared byte by byte
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen Phase1 matching F and three matching source-only correction models; target labels absent
checkpoint.selection_rule: All three already frozen candidates, no target result selection

expected_artifacts: result.json parallel wall time, shared wall time and exact source comparison

dimensions: 112 source IQ records: 8 each for two RX groups and seven views

rows.method: Compare three simultaneous independent source workers with one shared inference process
rows.purpose: Measure actual parallel comparison and exact source output equivalence
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.

notes: All models frozen before F is used for source prediction; no TX truth, V or target data.
Model loading and process startup excluded; output serialization included and parallel output transfer included.
Single timing; does not establish full target output equivalence or alter active tasks.
Technical retry after r01 spawn-import failure; frozen loader modifies sys.path, so workers start with initial paths; source model and benchmark protocol unchanged.
